scope: Read-only wording clarification and binding of the subsequently retrieved Windows Application Error event. The original stop review is preserved unchanged. No Python, training, GPU, source edit, environment change, or dependency operation was performed.

authorization_clarification.meaning: The user authorized the bounded continuation segment. Execution stopped because its mandatory CPU continuity/resume gate did not pass, not because human authorization was absent. A later explicitly reviewed run may proceed under that existing scope only after its own complete CPU gate passes.

corrected_causal_statement: The event confirms that the recorded base-Python process terminated with a native access violation in the NumPy generator extension. It does not establish the underlying corruption source, memory exhaustion, a NumPy-version defect, or a continuation-logic defect, and it does not prove that any later runtime selection has repaired the cause.
